title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Strawberry Raspberry Cherry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Strawberry Raspberry Cherry combines three bright berry flavours for a sweet, layered vape. Juicy Strawberry and tangy Raspberry meet rich Cherry for a balanced blend that’s fruity and satisfying. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod arrives as a prefilled 2ml pod linked to an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, giving 12ml total of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No bottles, no refilling, and no coil changes—simply attach to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. The dual mesh coil provides consistent vapour and clean flavour for up to 6000 puffs (approx.). Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
